title: A DROPPED ARMOURY GUN IS NEVER IN TWO SAVES
why: Found by the second review of the night builds (2026-10-09). The v21.21 fix kept a dropped armoury gun on your lists so an abandon brings it home, but then if you abandoned and the other player took the gun afterwards, it ended up in both saves, and a reload after a closed window did the same. Now the drop is written down: an abandon still brings the gun home, a closed window does not, and when the other player takes it the game takes it back out of your armoury if the abandon had put it there.
now: In co-op, an armoury gun you drop is never copied into both saves.
